summary: Iteration 20: Full backend + frontend regression on Auth v2 (cookies + CSRF + MFA + brute-force + admin ops + refresh rotation). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_auth_v2.py (14 tests, all PASS via httpx to bypass the conftest requests-patch). Frontend: verified login-error, MFA challenge flow for direttore, /sicurezza page (mfa-card, password-form, sessions-card, 'Attiva'), logout + protected-route redirect, google-login-button on /login, fan login → /account, and auto-refresh after deleting only the access_token cookie. One CRITICAL frontend bug found on /admin/utenti.

ui_bugs.issue: UsersPage crashes with 'ReferenceError: UserActions is not defined' inside its Array.map row renderer, so /admin/utenti renders the ErrorBoundary ('Qualcosa è andato storto'). The component <UserActions u={u} me={user} onChanged={load} /> is referenced on line 62 but never imported nor defined in the file. Only definition is a local (non-exported) component in /app/frontend/src/components/layout/PublicShell.jsx which is a completely different UserActions (props: user/landing/onLogout).

integration_issues.flow: Admin Users management (temp password, toggle status, MFA column)
integration_issues.issue: Because UsersPage crashes, the review-required test ids user-mfa-<email>, user-temp-password-<email>, user-toggle-status-<email>, temp-password-dialog and temp-password-value cannot be rendered. Backend endpoints work (see TestAdminUserOps in test_auth_v2.py which exercises the full referee lifecycle end-to-end via API).

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Users.jsx: implement (or import) a UserActions component that renders the required buttons/testids (user-mfa-<email>, user-temp-password-<email> opening a Dialog with data-testid=temp-password-dialog + inner data-testid=temp-password-value, and user-toggle-status-<email> with a confirmation). Currently the reference on line 62 is undefined causing the whole page to fall into the ErrorBoundary.
critical_code_review_comments: Users.jsx references an undefined <UserActions/> component (line 62). The bundle throws 'ReferenceError: UserActions is not defined' and the entire /admin/utenti page is replaced by the ErrorBoundary — this is a P0 regression that blocks all admin user management from the UI.

The MFA/disable endpoint POST /api/auth/mfa/disable requires body {password, code} not just {code}; frontend Security.jsx should confirm this contract when exposing an MFA disable action for non-mandatory roles.
GET /api/auth/sessions returns {current: <sid>, items: [...]} (not a flat list). Any frontend or third-party consumer should not assume a flat array.

Password policy: >=10 chars + letters + digits enforced on POST /auth/register and admin user creation. Registration form label still says 'min. 8 caratteri' (Register.jsx line 64) which is now inconsistent with the enforced backend rule (>=10). Minor UX/consistency issue.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 review UI flows PASS; Users admin page crashes)

Brute-force lockout is executed against unique random emails (@test.it) to avoid locking real accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth v2 is fully green. To exercise it, run: python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auth_v2.py -v -o addopts='' (httpx bypasses the requests monkey-patch installed in conftest.py; conftest still needed to keep the legacy suite passing). Sessions API returns {current, items[]}. MFA-disable requires {password, code}. Frontend has a P0 bug on /admin/utenti (UserActions undefined) — fix that first, then re-run TEST_C from iteration_20 which validates user-mfa-<email>, user-temp-password-<email>, user-toggle-status-<email>, temp-password-dialog and temp-password-value. Auto-refresh: removing only the access_token cookie while keeping refresh_token+csrf_token successfully re-authenticates the user via axios interceptor.
rca of the issue: Users.jsx renders <UserActions/> on line 62 but neither imports it nor defines it locally. Webpack DEV bundle throws ReferenceError inside the .map() callback → React error boundary catches it and renders the fallback screen instead of the users table. Fix: create/import a UserActions component that emits the required data-testids and calls the corresponding admin endpoints (PATCH /api/users/{id}/status, POST /api/users/{id}/temporary-password, POST /api/users/{id}/mfa/reset).
